summary: Independently reproduced the reported MiniMax H3 GGUF Conv3D load failure on the prepared base and verified candidate commit 43c24ad244462bcdfd0cd9054838428854223edc. The public GGUF patch tensor and the pinned native MiniMax-H3 safetensors patch tensor were range-fetched and are byte-identical (SHA256 c53b1d553bc8ed5e7c041726fc8122cce21d8bd1cbeb9ad423476c33128334ff), proving that reshaping checkpoint (3456,2,16,16) to parameter (1152,3,2,16,16) restores the actual contiguous [out_channels,input_channels] fold. The candidate limits restoration to the named floating-point Conv3D tensor with exact axis compatibility and rejects malformed and packed inputs. Its focused suites pass, and a real-artifact GPU Conv3D matches an independent flattened dot-product reference. The original load-time contract is fully resolved; full video/audio generation remains outside the verified scope.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction through the production GGUF metadata/iterator and MiniMax loader; failure reported checkpoint=(3456, 2, 16, 16), parameter=(1152, 3, 2, 16, 16). Raw log: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-822844b73e9c/evidence/base_reproduction.log

53 tests passed, covering real-reader folded BF16 loading, native unfurled, malformed, noncontiguous, packed-storage rejection, GPU numerical behavior, and adjacent GGUF loader regressions. Raw log and JUnit XML are retained outside the checkout.

tests.command: Range-fetch public GGUF bytes [18209217664,18212756607] and pinned native safetensors bytes [3261849648,3265388591], then sha256sum and cmp
tests.what_was_measured: The actual public GGUF BF16 patch tensor and native FL2VA tensor are both 3,538,944 bytes, have SHA256 c53b1d553bc8ed5e7c041726fc8122cce21d8bd1cbeb9ad423476c33128334ff, and compare byte-identical. This independently establishes the checkpoint axis convention rather than assuming it from equal element counts.

The real public GGUF tensor passed through the production iterator and candidate loader, exactly matched the native checkpoint tensor, and produced MI350X Conv3D output matching an independent flattened dot-product reference with max absolute error 0.006331920623779297.
Confirmed sglang and both affected loader modules imported from /job/repo/python, not an installed wheel. Evidence: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-822844b73e9c/evidence/import-paths.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) under Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015 ran the candidate's GPU test and the independent real-checkpoint Conv3D comparison.

remaining_limitations: Full MiniMax H3 video/audio serving and generation were not run and remain unverified; the reviewed original issue is specifically the pre-inference text-encoder load failure.
Validation used ROCm 7.2 on AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), not the reporter's CUDA 13 / RTX 5090 SM12.x environment.
No C++/FlyDSL/native source changed in the candidate, so no native rebuild was applicable.

The candidate comment's attribution to llama.cpp is imprecise: current llama.cpp Qwen3-VL conversion splits Conv3D along the temporal axis. This does not affect the code's correctness for the documented Unsloth artifact, whose GGUF and pinned native tensor bytes were directly compared.
